<We keep running into these... manikins...>
<从刚才起就一直……能看到这些人偶……>

LCE Research Team Hallway
LCE研究组 走廊

dataList.content:
<Are they made by those "Nursefathers?">
<是那些被称为父辈的人做的吗？>

Yes. To be more specific, it's just the Ring Nursefather.
没错。准确来说，只有环指父辈一人。

Corporism—an art movement that utilizes the interaction between human bones and muscles, the contraction and the elongation thereof. ... With a splash of Cubist technique, it seems.
人体派。利用人的肌肉与骨骼进行收缩与舒张的艺术。……在那之上，也稍稍掺了一些立体主义元素。

... Nasty.
……真是恶趣味。

Observe closer—do you see them?
看到了吗？

Writings, carved into their... bodies.
他们的……身上……似乎刻有文字。

These corpses were engraved with a wild scrawl of a message, carved with a blade.
仿佛用刀粗暴划过般的文字，刻写在了许多尸体上。

They began shuffling at us in that uncanny rhythm entirely devoid of any semblance of will.
他们以看似没有意识的动作，向这边靠近。

"Dearest..."
我们亲爱的……

Dearest daughter of ours,
我们亲爱的女儿。

please pay close attention to the way the line curves.
请注意看这条曲线。

From ribs, we can make blades keener than any sword; from femurs, we can make bludgeons sturdier than any mace.
只要护理得当，肋骨可以成为最锋利的刀刃，而股骨则可以成为最结实的钝器。

The thoracic cage has taken this prepossessing yet hardy shape of an arch to keep the heart and the lungs from harm.
胸廓是为了保护心脏和肺部，才形成了如此坚固而美丽的拱形。

Preserve this natural beauty of the human corpus and do not infringe upon its primeval, precise value...
在保持这具身体美丽形态的同时，不损伤身体原有的精巧价值……

That is the reverence with which the act of creation must be handled—just as musicians handle a priceless instrument.
必须像使用珍贵乐器般，进行制作才好。

Touch it, if you will. Do your fingertips feel the contour of a blade along the grains of musculature, its tendons and sinews?
请试着摸一摸，沿着肌肉与肌腱的纤维，你能感觉到刀刃的形状逐渐显现吗？

The bones of the one most desperate for life... have become a blade best fit to reap it.
最想活下去的家伙的骨头……已经成为了最适合杀戮的刀刃吗。

Indeed it has, hasn't it? I knew from the fathoms of my heart that you could appreciate the true value of this piece, Yoshihide.
没错吧？我认为<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>，一定可以意识到它真正的价值。

The care put into this piece I have so painstakingly birthed into the world is greater than that of any other work of mine. The smallest fracture or imbalance could instantly render it useless.
我倾注了所有心血，以制作这孩子。哪怕有一点破碎或是骨骼不平衡，都会立即使它失去价值。

Once this piece is complete, dearest Yoshihide, I would like for you to wield it.
一旦完成，就请<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>来使用吧。

I will.
好吧。

Never got to finish that precious piece he'd always ramble about... did he?
那整日挂在嘴边的作品……终究，还是没能完成吗？
